siteTagline: Class notes, practical guides, and cheat sheets for the IT program at Hunar Institute — free to download, anytime.
author: M.Khan Jamali
institute: Hunar Institute of Vocational Training, Dadu
aboutText: Hunar IT Hub is a free, open library of class notes for the IT program at Hunar Institute of Vocational Training, Dadu. Every file here is the same material covered in class, organized into a searchable archive — so revising for a test or catching up after missing a session takes minutes, not a message to your teacher. No sign-in, no fees, no ads.

categories.name: Computer Fundamentals
categories.description: Hardware, software, and the basics every student starts with.

files.title: Unit 1 · Introduction to Computers
files.description: What a computer is, the IPO cycle, history of computers, and types of computers.

files.title: Unit 2 · Parts of a Computer (Hardware)
files.description: Internal hardware (CPU, RAM, hard disk, motherboard) and external peripherals.

files.title: Unit 3 · Software
files.description: System software vs application software, the operating system, and everyday apps.

files.title: Unit 4 · Input & Output Devices
files.description: The IPO cycle in detail, input devices, and output devices.

files.title: Unit 5 · Storage Devices
files.description: Primary vs. secondary storage, units of storage (Bit to Petabyte), and storage devices like HDD, SSD, USB, and Cloud.

files.title: Unit 7 · Operating Systems
files.description: What an operating system is, what it does, popular desktop and mobile systems, and how a computer starts up.

files.title: Unit 8 · The Windows Desktop
files.description: The Desktop, parts of the screen, taskbar & system tray, finding programs, and window buttons (minimize, maximize, close, move & resize).

files.title: Unit 9 · Mouse & Keyboard Skills
files.description: Mouse actions (click, double-click, right-click, drag, scroll), keyboard shortcuts, deleting files safely, and special keys.

files.title: Unit 10 · File Management (Part 1)
files.description: What files and folders are, common file types, File Explorer, creating and renaming files/folders, and naming rules.

categories.name: MS Word Essentials
categories.description: Formatting, templates, and everyday document skills.

files.title: Chapter 1 · Getting Started with MS Word
files.description: Navigating the Word interface, creating & saving documents, opening existing files, and exporting to PDF.

files.title: Chapter 2 · Basic Text Entry & Editing
files.description: Typing and cursor movement, selecting text, cut/copy/paste, and undo, redo, find & replace.

files.title: Chapter 3 · Character Formatting
files.description: Bold, italic & underline, font & font size, font color & highlighting, and text effects & case.

files.title: Chapter 4 · Paragraph Formatting
files.description: Paragraph alignment, line & paragraph spacing, indents, and borders & shading.

files.title: Chapter 6 · Working with Lists
files.description: Bulleted lists, numbered lists, multilevel lists, and customizing list styles.

files.title: Chapter 7 · Page Setup & Layout
files.description: Margins, orientation & paper size, columns, and page & section breaks.

files.title: Chapter 8 · Headers, Footers & Page Numbers
files.description: Headers, footers, page numbers, and different first-page/odd-even settings.

files.title: Chapter 9 · Working with Tables
files.description: Inserting tables, adding/removing rows & columns, formatting table styles, and merging, splitting & sorting table data.

categories.name: Browsing Internet & Managing Emails
categories.description: A 16-chapter course on browsers, safe browsing, and everyday email management.

files.title: Chapter 1 · Internet Fundamentals
files.description: What the internet is, how it works, and how to search.

files.title: Chapter 2 · Web Browsers
files.description: Exploring browsers, their features, and how to use them.

files.title: Chapter 3 · Effective Browsing
files.description: Navigation, tabs, history, and smart search techniques.

files.title: Chapter 4 · Download & Upload
files.description: Managing file transfers between your device and the internet.

files.title: Chapter 5 · Browser Settings
files.description: Customising your browser for security, privacy, and efficiency.

files.title: Chapter 6 · Extensions
files.description: Enhancing browser functionality with add-ons.

files.title: Chapter 7 · Bookmarks
files.description: Understanding bookmarks vs. history, creating and organizing bookmarks with folders, and syncing or backing them up.

files.title: Chapter 8 · Email Introduction
files.description: How email works (compose, SMTP, DNS lookup, delivery), comparing providers like Gmail and Outlook, and reading a valid email address.

files.title: Chapter 9 · Creating Accounts
files.description: Step-by-step Gmail signup, setting up Outlook or ProtonMail, enabling two-factor authentication, personal vs. professional email, and logging in/out securely.

files.title: Chapter 10 · Email Settings
files.description: Accessing email settings, creating a signature, strengthening account security, and backing up & restoring emails.

files.title: Chapter 11 · Composing Emails
files.description: Composing a new email, using To/CC/BCC correctly, writing effective subject lines, and formatting & sending emails.

files.title: Chapter 12 · Attachments
files.description: Attaching files to emails, common file types, downloading attachments safely, and spotting suspicious attachments.

files.title: Chapter 13 · Managing Spam
files.description: Understanding spam, spotting warning signs, managing your spam folder, and preventing spam proactively.

files.title: Chapter 14 · Email Organization
files.description: Organizing with folders and labels, searching and filtering, starring/flagging, and email etiquette.

files.title: Chapter 15 · Internet Safety
files.description: Recognizing phishing and scams, safe browsing habits, passwords and account security, and protecting your privacy online.

files.title: Chapter 16 · Cloud Storage
files.description: What cloud storage is, uploading and organizing files, sharing and collaboration, and syncing across devices.

files.title: Complete Course · All 16 Chapters
files.description: The full slide deck for Browsing Internet & Manage Emails in one file — all 16 chapters, editable in PowerPoint.
